name: mediqueue
description: MediQueue — intelligent clinic appointment, token queue and waiting-time management (local-first CAD project)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
